Genuine captures from the test app with synthetic tasks · bottom of the screen at the same scale
N3 · corrected: + aligned to the capsule
Genuine · your iPhone, iOS 27.0.1
Measured on your iPhone, three runs: capsule and + both 62 pt, top, centre and bottom offsets 0.00 pt; capsule 16 pt from the left, 8 pt gap, + 16 pt from the right; Day ▾ 16 pt above.
N3 · first build (before the fix)
Genuine · your iPhone, iOS 27.0.1
The + was centred on the tab bar's whole 83 pt view, but iOS draws the 62 pt glass capsule at the top of that view, so the + sat 11 pt low.
Apple's own separate slot, tried first
Genuine · your iPhone, iOS 27.0.1
Using iOS's search-tab slot for Add: on iOS 27 it shows as a fifth item inside the bar, not a separate circle; even Apple's search tab stays inside on iOS 27. So the circle has to be our own button.
N3 · whole screen
Genuine · your iPhone, iOS 27.0.1
Flutter content scrolls under all three native glass controls.

What the native build showed

  • Works on iOS 26+ only: the glass button styles (glass, prominent glass) need iOS 26; Dottoday supports iOS 16, so older iPhones need a fallback (solid teal + and the classic bar).
  • Composed, not system-managed: N3 is our own native tab bar plus native buttons in a native root, with Flutter behind. iOS will not place a circle beside its own tab bar on iOS 27, so the arrangement is ours to maintain.
  • Teal tint works: the + keeps Dottoday teal as genuine tinted glass, with a white plus.
  • Alignment must follow the capsule: iOS's glass capsule is smaller than the tab bar's view and sits at its top; the + is aligned to the capsule's measured frame, not to the bar view. With larger text or a future iOS the capsule can change, so the alignment is recomputed on each layout (implementation rule).
  • Not yet checked by hand: tapping +, Day and tabs; VoiceOver order; Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast on this row (your phone's settings).

What changes

Now (approved)Proposed
Tab bar16 pt from both edges, 358 wide on a 390 pt phone, 62 tall, glassLeft 16, right 86: 288 wide, 62 tall, same glass; four tabs at 72 pt each
+ (Add)52 pt solid teal circle, in the row above the bar on the right62 pt circle in the bar's line, 8 pt right of the bar; teal Liquid Glass (94 → 88 % teal, blur and edge light like the bar); white plus 28 pt; same hold menu
Day ▾Glass chip, left of the row above the barSame glass chip, moved right, where the + was
Row above the barDay + AddDay only (Calendar tab: empty)
White plus on the teal glass7.27:1 on solid teal≈ 5.7–7.2:1 over white, cream and task colours (tint never below 88 %)
Touch targets+ 52, Day 44+ 62, Day 44, tabs 72 × 62

Notes

  • Scope: iPhone only, Full and Minimal: all 12 iPhone frames with the tab bar would change if you approve (7 on E-Phones, 5 on E-PhonesMinimal). Android, Mac, web and iPad are unchanged.
  • Native fit: this matches iOS 26's own layout, where a separate circle sits beside the tab bar (Apple uses it for Search). A native build of it runs on your iPhone (section below).
  • Accessibility: + stays one button with the same label and hold menu; with Reduce Transparency it becomes solid teal; with Increase Contrast it gets a solid edge. The + edge relies on its rim and shadow over dark task colours.
  • Reach: Day ▾ moves to the right-hand side; left-handed reach is slightly longer.
  • Not merged: drawn here only; no E board changed.
